references.text: Jeremiah warns of the consequences for an evil generation, which mirrors Jesus' warnings against his generation.
Ezekiel's use of 'this generation' in his prophecies about judgment can be seen as parallel to Jesus' words.
Jesus again confirms that this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened, paralleling the warning in Matthew 23:36.
Luke repeats Jesus' warning that this generation will be held accountable, paralleling Matthew 23:36.
Luke's version of Jesus' words that this generation will not pass away, paralleling Matthew 23:36.
